reason: Instagram already fills my Friday and Saturday nights and it costs me nothing. I'd maybe let them list me for free since it's no effort, but I wouldn't pay for a plan.
objection: 500 people on a waitlist is nothing, and I don't see why I'd pay for views when my own Instagram already reaches my crowd.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that the app brings in new people on my slow weekday nights, with real numbers from my own city, before I pay anything.
